names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 24 Απριλίου, «Όσιος Αλέξιος ο Έγκλειστος», with the rank word and the epithet left off; the Lavra in the English form is the one the page names.

Read out of the title on the name link behind the line for 24 апреля ст. ст., name page 133, «Преподобный Алексий, затворник Печерский», with the rank word «Преподобный» left off and the rest taken whole; the day’s own line gives the same words in the genitive, «Алексия , затворника Печерского». «затворник», the recluse, is kept inside the form because it is how the calendar always prints this man — line, name page and both lives alike — and because the bare «Алексий» would fold onto many folders. Measured against the gate’s own key function before it was written: 'алексии затворник печерскии' has no other holder in the corpus.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 24 апреля ст. ст. — «Прп. Алексия , затворника Печерского (XIII).»
source.note: The day’s eighth entry. The name link, page 133, is titled «Преподобный Алексий, затворник Печерский» and is an INDEX, not a life: it lists two readings and both were read, life6399 and life926, which say the same thing in two lengths. Both head «Дни памяти: 24 апреля , 28 сентября (Печер.(Б))». 28 сентября is the synaxis of the fathers of the Near Caves, a synaxis and not a second feast; the second Sunday of Great Lent, the synaxis of all the Kyiv Caves wonderworkers, is moveable and cannot be held. The folder renders on 24 апреля ст. ст. only. THE PAGE SAYS WHY THE DAY IS HIS, AND IT IS NOT HIS DEATH: «Память преподобного Алексия совершается 24 апреля потому, что его мощи почивают рядом с мощами преподобного Саввы Печерского» — because his relics rest beside those of Sabbas of the Caves, whose own day this is, and whose day is itself a day of a shared name with the martyr Sabbas Stratelates. So this row stands at two removes from any event of his own life. `dates` WRITTEN WHERE THE FOLDER HAD NONE AT ALL, as a FLORUIT: «подвизался в Ближних пещерах ... в XIII веке», with the relics opened after 1675, which is a date of the finding and not of the man. THE DAY PAGE PRINTS TWO HYMNS ADDRESSED TO HIM AND SABBAS TOGETHER and both are on both folders now. Not checked: azbyka.ru, and the 28 сентября day page.

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 24ης Απριλίου — «Όσιος Αλέξιος ο Έγκλειστος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 24 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page puts him in Russia in the thirteenth century, a monk enclosed in the Great Lavra of Kyiv, dead in peace; says outright that «Ο βίος του Αγίου δεν καταγράφηκε», his life was never written down; and records that his relics were found again in 1675 thanks to a landslide following an earthquake that struck Kyiv that year, and were then laid beside those of Sabbas of the Lavra of the Caves of Kyiv. It adds that his memory is also kept on 28 Σεπτεμβρίου, in the common feast of the monks of the Lavra of the near caves, and in the second week of Lent, in the common commemoration of the wonderworking Fathers of the Caves of Kyiv — two further commemorations which this schema cannot hold as feasts and which are recorded here instead. It gives no year of birth or death, so no `dates` were taken, and prints no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).

floruit.note: days.pravoslavie.ru, life926: «Преподобный Алексий, затворник Печерский, подвизался в Ближних пещерах Киево-Печерского монастыря в XIII веке» — he struggled in the Near Caves of the Kyiv Caves monastery in the thirteenth century; life6399 says the same. It is recorded as a FLORUIT and not as a death because that is what the sentence gives: no year or century of repose is printed anywhere. The 1675 both pages name — «Мощи святого были обретены после 1675 года» — is the finding of the relics and not a date of his life, so it was not used as one. The corpus’s first years of any kind for him: the folder held no `dates` object at all.

hymns.text: Преблаженнии и Богоноснии отцы наши Савво и Алексие,/ яко стяжавший дерзновение ко Господу/ равноангельным своим житием,/ егоже ради обогати Христос/ нетлением и чудесы мощи ваша,/ молим вас прилежно:/ испросите душам нашим очищение/ и велию и богатую милость.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 24 апреля ст. ст. — «Тропарь преподобных Саввы и Алексия Печерских», глас 3, under «Молитвы»
source.note: ADDRESSED TO TWO MEN AND NAMING NOBODY ELSE — «отцы наши Савво и Алексие» — so it is the proper of both and it is on both folders, this one and `sabbas-of-the-kyiv-caves`. It is the first hymn of any kind on either. Copied whole off the page and checked back against it by whitespace-normalised match.

english.text: O most blessed and God-bearing fathers of ours, Sabbas and Alexios, who gained boldness before the Lord by your manner of life equal to the angels, for the sake of which Christ enriched your relics with incorruption and with wonders: we pray you earnestly, ask for our souls cleansing, and great and abundant mercy.

hymns.text: Богатство благодати и сыноположения стяжаете/ многими подвиги и добродетельми,/ ихже ради Христос всели души ваша/ в Небесныя селения Своя,/ даровав благодать нетления/ и чудес мощем вашим,/ сего ради вопием вам:/ радуйтеся, Савво и Алексие,/ ликов иноческих похвале и украшение.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 24 апреля ст. ст. — «Кондак преподобных Саввы и Алексия Печерских», глас 4, under «Молитвы»
source.note: Addressed to the same two men and naming nobody else, «радуйтеся, Савво и Алексие», so it is on both folders. Copied whole off the page and checked back against it.

english.text: The riches of grace and of adoption as sons ye gained by many labours and virtues, for the sake of which Christ settled your souls in His heavenly dwellings, granting the grace of incorruption and of wonders to your relics. Wherefore we cry out to you: rejoice, Sabbas and Alexios, the praise and the adornment of the monastic choirs.
